scope: Scottish Psalter portion only. Psalm 119’s 22 printed sections are combined so the result aligns with 150 primary and 13 alternate text-version records.

source.title: Sing Psalms and Scottish Psalter with Bookmarks and Tune Recommendations
source.extraction_note: Text produced with pdftotext -layout; recommendation strings were checked against page renderings for the listed identity conflicts.

verse_range_notes.note: Unqualified recommendations coexist with a verse-specific supplement.

wrapped_source_block.note: The unqualified six-tune recommendation is physically wrapped across two source lines; it is parsed as one group while both source lines are retained.

notes: The three tune-number/name conflicts are printed in the PDF and were visually verified; values are preserved, not corrected.
Psalm 43 has an unqualified recommendation group plus a v 3-5 supplement.
Psalm 86 overlaps v 8-9 across adjacent recommendation ranges.
Psalm 107 overlaps v 15-16 and v 31-32 across adjacent recommendation ranges. No annotated record has a coverage gap.
